title: Madamina! Il catalogo è questo
subtitle: Leporello: aria from Don Giovanni, Act 1 (No. 4)

passages.label: Madamina! Il catalogo è questo … osservate, leggete con me!
In Italia sei cento e quaranta … mille e tre!
V'han fra queste contadine … d'ogni forma, d'ogni età
The count again: In Italia … ma in Ispagna son già mille e tre
mille e tre! · V'han fra queste contadine (again) … d'ogni età!
Andante con moto: Nella bionda … la grande maestosa
La piccina … pel piacer di porle in lista
Sua passion predominante … voi sapete quel che fa
Pur che porti la gonnella … quel che fa (to the end)

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Don Giovanni, K. 527 (1787), Act 1 scene 5, No. 4 Aria

licences.notes: Words as printed in the Schirmer vocal score (amo without its accent in bar 6, fatto io, Almagna, sei cento / due cento / trent' una / novant' una as separate words, citadine once in bar 72, di lodarla la gentilezza, e la grande maestosa, purchè and pur che; the libretto has amò, fatt'io, Lamagna, seicento, cittadine, di lodar la gentilezza and è la grande).

licences.source: G. Schirmer vocal score, New York 1900 (plate 15147, IMSLP #68957), pages 42–49, bars 1–172 of No. 4
licences.author: G. Schirmer, piano reduction as printed
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the sung line and the piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar and checked again by a fresh checker. The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out; Donna Elvira is on stage but does not sing. Where the print gives the voice extra stems or small notes for the English words (bars 30, 34, 36, 64, 68, 70), the Italian rhythm is kept; in bar 82, where the voice is printed in octaves, the lower (sung) notes are kept. Playback tempo: Allegro ♩ = 156 (bars 1–84) and Andante con moto ♩ = 78 (bars 85–172), about 5:32 before the fermatas, from the median (5:34) of four complete recordings whose track holds the aria alone (Giulini 1959 5:26, Haitink 1984 5:54, Karajan 1985 5:42, Jacobs 2006 5:15); the tracks are not split at the Andante, so its quarter note is set to the Allegro's half note. Mozart gives the words only.
